label: Diagonal branch of anterior descending branch of left coronary artery
synonyms: Diagonal branch of anterior interventricular branch of left coronary artery
Diagonal branch of left coronary artery
Large anterior ventricular branch of left coronary artery
Large left anterior ventricular branch of anterior interventricular artery

tier1.text: Branch of anterior interventricular branch of left coronary artery which arises from the terminal end of the left coronary artery between the angle formed by the anterior interventricular branch and the circumflex branch of the left coronary artery and supplies the left ventricle.
